info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Contribution Models Management API
info.description: The Contribution Models Management API enables businesses to configure and manage various contribution models within their banking service offerings. This API facilitates the creation of new contribution models, allowing financial institutions to tailor their services to align with specific customer needs and regulatory requirements. Typical consumers include banking developers and financial service providers looking to enhance their product offerings. This resource plays a crucial role in optimizing financial strategies and improving customer engagement.

post.description: This endpoint allows developers to create a new contribution model within the system. A contribution model defines the parameters and guidelines for contributions, which can be utilized across various applications. Ensure all required fields are included in the request body for successful model creation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new contribution model. The body must adhere to the specified schema and include all required fields to ensure successful model creation.
